qualityWarnings: Generation record is not independent verification. No technical/adversarial verdict, rubric or final attestation was authored.

The Question schema requires GA or Preview and has no unknown option. GA is the candidate baseline classification, not an independently established maturity verdict. The current admitted sources document baseline implementation but generally do not explicitly certify release status; reviewers must evaluate this residual gap, not inherit the prior GA flags.

Current OpenTelemetry product documentation labels Python Live Metrics with Preview terms. No candidate tests Live Metrics, Java preview overrides, community experimental instrumentation or GenAI feedback extensions.
Advanced/Expert quota is not inflated: most retained repairs are ordinary Intermediate implementation or diagnosis. Source-bounded deep join cardinality is Advanced; no Expert item is claimed.

New r-s-002 distinguishes encrypted backup restore from live value/metadata APIs; no nonexistent local decryption or cross-subscription restore option is used. r-s-003 compares valid scoped-client lifetimes with service-lifetime reuse; no leaking-client design is offered as a legitimate alternative.
